result.topic_en: This page ends Euler's table of values of a for which aa+1 is a prime above one million, counts the large primes found, and begins a list of values of a for which (aa+1)/2 is prime.

items.quote: Habentur ergo hic 112 numeri primi maiores quam 100000 et 49 numeri primi millionem ſuperantes.
items.english: Here, therefore, we have 112 prime numbers greater than 100000, and 49 prime numbers exceeding a million.

items.quote: Praeterea autem plures numeri primi formarum $\frac{aa+1}{2}$, $\frac{aa+1}{5}$, $\frac{aa+1}{10}$ aſſignari poſſunt, qui etiam centena millia ſuperant; vt ex ſequentibus perſpicere licet:
items.english: Moreover, many more prime numbers of the forms (aa+1)/2, (aa+1)/5 and (aa+1)/10 can be assigned which also exceed a hundred thousand, as can be seen from what follows.
